newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ticks ahead in calm pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ticks ahead in calm pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Shares traded slightly higher on Wednesday, with Nokia building on gains it racked up after reporting first quarter results on Tuesday, and the HEX index was seen staying in positive territory, brokers said.
"It would take some bad figures to turn this market negative," one broker said, referring to U.S. first quarter GDP and price data due at 1530/1230 GMT.
Nokia traded touched 324.00 markka in hefty 160 million markka volume, the retreated slightly to 322.10, up 0.20. One broker said next resistance was at 330.00, support at 318.00.
Rautaruukki fell 1.00 markka to 45.50, but was still above the price in a recent offering at 42.00 markka per share as foreign interest in the share remained high after the offering, brokers said.
Polar fell 0.45 markka to 6.70 in thin trade after warning that its full-year 1997 operating result was not expected to improve on 1996.
Asko rose 3.00 markka to 95.00 in very heavy trade that stemmed from big in-house block deals.
